annotation.title_clean: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework (Second Edition)
annotation.title_en: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework (Second Edition)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA); Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC), Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore IMDA/PDPC's voluntary, sector- and technology-agnostic Model AI Governance Framework (2nd ed., January 2020). It turns ethical principles into practical guidance in four areas: internal governance, the level of human involvement in AI decisions, operations management (data, bias, robustness, auditability) and stakeholder communication. Robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organisations should set up internal governance structures with clear roles and responsibilities for AI
The level of human involvement (human-in-, over-, or out-of-the-loop) should be determined by the probability and severity of harm
Risk-based operations management covering data lineage, bias mitigation, robustness, reproducibility and auditability
Transparent communication and interaction with stakeholders, including explanations and feedback channels
Algorithm audits only when necessary and at a regulator's request
